Wikipedia (Quiksilver): Roxy launched in 1990 as Quiksilver's sister brand for young women; owned by Boardriders, which Authentic Brands Group bought in 2023; Roxy's US retail stores closed when Liberated Brands liquidated in 2025 (us_stores left empty).
